prerequisites: Students must master certain specific mathematical and physical (statics) knowledge.

learning_outcomes.text: Students apply the concepts of structural calculation and design of steel and concrete structures using commercial software for practical problems related to mechanical engineering.
Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for their concretization and clear and concise presentation.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for finding sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability for teamwork and capacity for the development of multidisciplinary projects.

assessment_methods.method: Execution of practical and mandatory exercises with defense
Activity on the Studium virtual platform
Tutorials and other assignments proposed throughout the course

assessment_rules: It is necessary to obtain a minimum score of 5 out of 10 in each of the assessment sections to pass the course.
